dict.string: Hourly GitHub-issues SLA watcher for stuinfla/ruvnet-brain (Stuart's mandate: no open issue may sit >4h without an owner response). Runs scripts/issue-watch.mjs, which alerts via ntfy (urgent, topic from ~/.cache/ruvnet-brain/ntfy-topic) when an issue has been open >4h with no comment from stuinfla, deduped to at most one alert per issue per 4h window (state: ~/.claude/ruvnet-brain/issue-watch-state.json). Wrapped in job-heartbeat.sh per the house positive-confirmation pattern (see config/scheduled-jobs.json, scripts/nightly-watchdog.mjs) — a crash still leaves a receipt and pages the phone; silence is not health.
